Wisconsin Manufacturers & Commerce

Registered Principal Details

Business Or Interest:
The businesses community as a whole, including manufacturing, energy, retail, agriculture, health care, food processing, banking, insurance, mining and other service sectors.

Lobbying Interests:
WMC lobbies all issues pertaining to business with an emphasis on the following issue areas: taxation; labor relations; environment; business regulation; health care; civil justice; energy; transportation and workforce.
